assessment.behaviour_change: EditorComponent.ngOnInit now loads the article and checks ownership only when the route has a slug. Before, /editor (new article) also called GET /api/articles/undefined. A ShowAuthedDirective change (the source shows it as IfAuthenticatedDirective) is meant to stop duplicate embedded views. It now creates the view only once, and authRef is never reset when the view is cleared. A logout followed by a login could therefore fail to re-render authed content.
